name: nspb-rest-toolkit
description: Direct REST access to Oracle EPM Cloud Planning & Budgeting (NSPB) -- applications, dimensions, forms, jobs, migration, and more.
long_description: Talks directly to Oracle EPM Cloud's Planning & Budgeting REST APIs over HTTPS -- no Windows, PowerShell, or EPM Automate CLI dependency. Supports Basic Auth, OAuth2 (Device Code flow, for MFA-enforcing tenants), and static Bearer tokens. Reads are always safe to call; every destructive operation (writes, business rules, imports, status changes) requires an explicit confirmation step before it runs -- the model must describe the change and wait for you to approve before it's allowed to proceed.

base_url.title: EPM Base URL
base_url.description: Your Oracle EPM Cloud tenant base URL, e.g. https://<tenant>.epm.<region>.ocs.oraclecloud.com (no trailing path).

auth_method.title: Auth Method
auth_method.description: One of: basic, oauth2, bearer_token. Use 'basic' unless your tenant enforces MFA (then use 'oauth2') or you already have a static token (then use 'bearer_token').

username.title: Username (Basic Auth)
username.description: Only used when Auth Method is 'basic'.

password.title: Password (Basic Auth)
password.description: Only used when Auth Method is 'basic'. Stored securely by Claude Desktop, never in plain text.

bearer_token.title: Bearer Token
bearer_token.description: Only used when Auth Method is 'bearer_token' -- a pre-obtained static JWT from your Oracle Identity Domain console's 'Tokens and keys' page.

oauth2_idcs_base_url.title: OAuth2: IDCS Base URL
oauth2_idcs_base_url.description: Only used when Auth Method is 'oauth2'. Your Oracle Identity Domain's base URL, e.g. https://idcs-xxxx.identity.oraclecloud.com.

oauth2_client_id.title: OAuth2: Client ID
oauth2_client_id.description: Only used when Auth Method is 'oauth2'. The OAuth2 application's Client ID from the IDCS console.

oauth2_service_instance_id.title: OAuth2: Service Instance ID
oauth2_service_instance_id.description: Only used when Auth Method is 'oauth2'. Found on the app's OAuth configuration page (Primary audience: urn:opc:serviceInstanceID=<this value>).

oauth2_allow_refresh.title: OAuth2: Allow Refresh
oauth2_allow_refresh.description: Only used when Auth Method is 'oauth2'. Uncheck for session-only access, or if the app's IDCS config has 'Allow token refresh' set to Disallowed.

oauth2_client_secret.title: OAuth2: Client Secret
oauth2_client_secret.description: Only used when Auth Method is 'oauth2' AND the app is registered as a Confidential Application (has a Client Secret in the IDCS console). Leave blank for public-client apps.
